name: release_watch
description: Detect newly published stable releases from PyPI or GitHub without scraping HTML. The first check establishes a silent baseline. Later checks return changed=true until the caller acknowledges the release, allowing a workflow to create Canvas and alert artifacts before advancing state.

action.description: Check the upstream source or acknowledge a successfully handled version. Default: check.

watch_id.description: Stable local identifier for this release watch, such as yt-dlp-stable.

project.description: PyPI package name or GitHub owner/repository.

version.description: Version to persist after Canvas and alert steps succeed; required for acknowledge.

release_url.description: Optional release URL to retain with acknowledged state.

published_at.description: Optional upstream publication timestamp to retain with acknowledged state.
